nodes.description: Main contract storage struct Info holding totalSupply, token list, idOf, dictionary, resolve, users, metadata, owner and signer.
Public mapping(bytes4 => bool) advertising ERC-165 interface support.
Constant address(type(uint160).max) sentinel meaning a token uses the global cosigner.
Contract owner address stored inside Info; controls privileged setters.
Global signer address used for off-chain mint and record-update authorisation.
Number of minted YATs; incremented in _mint and used as token id bound.
Reference to the external Metadata contract used by all metadata getters.
Mapping(uint256 => Token) of all token data including owner, cosigner, approved, resolvesTo and records.
Mapping(address => User) holding balances, owned token index lists and operator approvals.
Mapping(bytes32 => uint256) mapping token hash to tokenId + 1 used for uniqueness.
Mapping(address => string) reverse resolution table written by _updateResolvesTo.
Deploys Metadata, sets info.owner = msg.sender, info.signer = _signer and registers interfaces.
Owner-only setter of info.owner.
Owner-only setter of info.signer.
Owner-only setter of info.metadata.
External mint requiring block.timestamp < _expiry and a valid signer signature before _mint.
Soft-burn: token owner transfers the token to the contract address itself.
Token-owner-only setter of the per-token cosigner.
Resets the token cosigner to USE_GLOBAL_SIGNER via setCosigner.
Revokes the token cosigner by setting address(0) via setCosigner.
Token-owner-only setter of the pointer address of a token.
Token-owner-only reverse-resolution setter delegating to _updateResolvesTo.
Clears reverse resolution by calling resolveTo(address(0), _tokenId).
Signature-authorized record update; uses and increments info.list[_tokenId].nonce before validation.
Record update restricted to token owner or cosigner, delegating to _updateRecord.
Deletes a record by delegating to updateRecord with an empty value and no auth modifier.
Owner/cosigner-only removal of all token records.
Token-owner-only approval of a single token id.
Sets operator approval for msg.sender in info.users.
External transfer entry point delegating to _transfer.
Three-argument safeTransferFrom forwarding to the four-argument overload.
Performs _transfer then, using extcodesize, invokes onERC721Received on the receiver.
Internal mint that creates a new token id or re-transfers a previously soft-burned token.
Core transfer logic: authorization checks, owner bookkeeping, record/resolution cleanup.
Internal reverse-resolution update/clear for a token.
Internal record add/update/delete with key dictionary maintenance.
Internal removal of a single record using swap-and-pop.
Internal loop deleting every record of a token.
Verifies the mint payload signature against signer().
Verifies the record-update signature against ownerOf or cosignerOf.
Recovers the signer address from an eth-signed hash and signature using ecrecover.
Splits a 65-byte signature into r, s and v using inline assembly.
Prefixes a message hash with the Ethereum Signed Message header.
Converts a string to bytes32 using inline assembly mload.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner().
Modifier requiring msg.sender == ownerOf(_tokenId).
Modifier requiring msg.sender to be the token owner or its cosigner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, approval and authorization checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp compared against the mint expiry.
External call Receiver(_to).onERC721Received executed after the transfer state changes.
ecrecover used without checking for a zero return address or signature malleability.
info.list[_tokenId].nonce++ is evaluated as an argument before the signature is validated.
Inline assembly extcodesize(_to) used to decide whether to invoke the receiver hook.
Inline assembly mload reads of the raw signature without validation of s range or v value.
External calls into the mutable info.metadata contract for all metadata getters.
burn() token id parameter.
mint() signature parameter consumed by _verifyMint.
Signature parameter of the signed updateRecord overload.
Receiver address parameter of safeTransferFrom used for the ERC721 receiver callback.
Approved address parameter of approve().
Local _owner in _transfer read from ownerOf(_tokenId).
Local _approved in _transfer read from getApproved(_tokenId).
Local _size in safeTransferFrom holding extcodesize(_to).
Local _hash of the mint payload in _verifyMint.

normalization_plan.reason: The _tokenId parameter only exists to serve burn's ownership check and _transfer call, so it should be normalized into the burn function node.
The _signature parameter is solely an input to mint's signature verification step and should be folded into the mint node.
The _signature parameter is only used for the signed overload's authorization and should merge into that function node.
The _to parameter drives the transfer and the receiver callback, so it normalizes into the four-argument safeTransferFrom node.
The _approved parameter is stored directly by approve and has no independent meaning outside that function.
The local _owner is a temporary read of ownerOf used only inside _transfer's authorization logic.
The local _approved is a temporary read of getApproved used only inside _transfer.
The local _size holds extcodesize(_to) and only gates the callback in safeTransferFrom.
The local _hash is the signed mint payload used only within _verifyMint's signature check.
